hints.title: Sort Bag Capacities
hints.text: Sort the beans array in non-decreasing order.

hints.title: Calculate Kept Beans
hints.text: If we choose beans[i] as the target non-empty capacity, all n - i bags with at least beans[i] beans retain exactly beans[i] beans.

hints.title: Maximize Total Kept
hints.text: The maximum remaining beans is max(beans[i] * (n - i)) across all i. The removed beans equals total sum minus maximum remaining.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minimumRemoval(self, beans: List[int]) -> int:
        beans.sort()
        total = sum(beans)
        n = len(beans)
        max_remaining = 0
        for i in range(n):
            max_remaining = max(max_remaining, beans[i] * (n - i))
        return total - max_remaining
```

complexity.notes: Greedy sorting and remaining bean maximization.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing arbitrary heights without sorting takes O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting brings evaluation of all candidate target heights to a single O(N) pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that only elements present in beans can serve as optimal non-empty bag heights.
